# Jolie Anastasia

> Jolie Anastasia is a folk and Americana singer-songwriter, born and raised in Collingwood, Ontario, and now based in Toronto. Her debut full-length album, Guiding Light (11 songs, released independently on November 7, 2025, produced by her father Craig Smith), is out now on Spotify and Apple Music.

This is the official website of Jolie Anastasia: https://jolieanastasia.ca/

## Key pages

- [Home](https://jolieanastasia.ca/): Biography, music video, album, band, press and contact
- [Listen to Guiding Light](https://jolieanastasia.ca/#listen): Debut album with Spotify and Apple Music links
- [Watch Lucky To Find](https://jolieanastasia.ca/#watch): Official music video for the lead single
- [Press](https://jolieanastasia.ca/#press): Reviews and interviews

## About

- Genre: Folk, Americana, roots, singer-songwriter
- Hometown: Collingwood, Ontario, Canada
- Based in: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- Sound: Layered harmonies, open tunings and a deep sense of place. Critics have compared her storytelling to Brandi Carlile, her guitar work to Phoebe Bridgers and her melodies to Madison Cunningham, with songs that "could live comfortably beside Joni Mitchell or Nick Drake."
- Influences: Joni Mitchell, Crosby, Stills, Nash & Young, The Byrds, Neil Young, Tony Rice, Norman Blake, Billy Strings, Gillian Welch

## Music

### Guiding Light (debut album, November 7, 2025)

Produced by Craig Smith. 11 songs, about 43 minutes.

1. Beating Sun
2. Lucky To Find
3. Cover My Tracks
4. Thin Air
5. Waterfall
6. Guiding Light
7. I Saw The Light
8. Winter's Song
9. Darkened Turn of Mind
10. Lose Me
11. Sound of a Shadow

- [Guiding Light on Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/album/7oXBKQb1y0KSObvMKHAV8V)
- [Guiding Light on Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/ca/album/guiding-light/1839327333)
- [Lucky To Find music video on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0VtTgFl3fWw) (lead single, released October 8, 2025)

## Band

- Jolie Anastasia: vocals, guitar, songwriting
- Braden Mahon: guitar
- Rae Melvin: drums and harmonica
- Kyle Dreany: bass
